_comment: Jev-engineering Phase 1 work queue template. The planner (jev-planner) runs on the high tier and writes only control data. Every Phase 2 task runs on a jev-executor-medium subagent; jev-executor-low is not used anywhere in this skill. All audit work (acceptance after each wave, T15 integration QA, pre-publish audit) runs on an independent high-tier auditor (opus, effort high) that re-runs the checks itself and never accepts worker self-report. A failed task goes back to the planner (replan); there is no high executor.

routing.fallback_if_plugin_agents_missing: Agent tool with model 'opus' + effort 'high' (planner, read-only) and model 'sonnet' (executors)
routing.on_failure: replan via jev-planner; do not escalate generation to high

auditor.inputs: TaskSpecs + references/ specs + artifact paths only; no worker reasoning or self-reports
when: pre-publish audit of the staged repo clone
auditor.on_fail: report to the planner for replan; next wave waits

parallel_waves.note: stops before push/merge; the user approves each

tasks.objective: PubMed/Crossref search for the method shard; record exact queries, dates and counts; every entry has a resolvable DOI or PMID.
Merge shard outputs into evidence_matrix.json, prisma_flow.json and references.bib; check external links.
acceptance: every bib key cited by a shard exists
year in each bib entry matches the source record
guideline citations (e.g. PRISMA-ScR) point to the guideline paper itself

tasks.objective: Run the real pipeline on synthetic + real data; write cube JSONs per references/deliverable_specs.md section 1 and demo_facts.json.
acceptance: orchestrator re-runs the run script and gets identical facts
targets that are missed are recorded as FAIL with details, not hidden
built from the real cube JSONs
GLB alignment checked in the browser (ground-truth ridge on the energy cloud)
scripts/smoke_test.cjs PASS on every page and dataset
audit_deliverables.py: no missing CSS classes, no missing local links
links work in both the Output layout and the repo layout
paper shown as a summary only unless the user approved publication
md_to_docx.py exits 0 (no missing citations / unknown LaTeX)
author/affiliation/funding/AI disclosure match the user's homepage or are placeholders
methods text matches the pipeline parameters
live widget loads the real cube
PowerPoint COM render to PNG, every slide inspected for overflow
smoke test clean on all pages; screenshots inspected
methods vs code params, author metadata vs homepage, citation support and BibTeX key-year checked
evidence saved to qa/; the orchestrator re-runs at least one gate itself
audit + smoke test on the clone
commit only; push and merge wait for the user
